name: Mishti doi
description: Bengali yogurt set with caramelised jaggery in an earthen pot.

ayurveda.note: Soured dahi is ushna; the jaggery adds to it.

unani.note: Thanda-tar, though warmer than plain dahi for the gur.

histamine.note: Cultured and then held warm to set — a longer ferment than plain dahi.

effects.note: Mishti doi is yogurt itself, set with caramelised jaggery in place of plain milk, carrying the same live cultures behind yogurt's own lactose-digestion effect — the dedicated trials tested plain yogurt rather than this sweetened version, but it is cultured the same way, not a different product. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
